Input, UMG screen ownership, options and accessibility

Route keyboard/mouse and controller input to one local screen/input owner. UI displays snapshots and sends intents; it cannot pause a shared server, grant items, edit skill ownership or directly mutate replicated attributes.

Scope and player interaction

Route keyboard/mouse and controller input to one local screen/input owner. UI displays snapshots and sends intents; it cannot pause a shared server, grant items, edit skill ownership or directly mutate replicated attributes.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase00committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

WorldInput → ModalInput → TargetingInput → ChatEntry → Loading → Disconnected

WBP_Options observes results from URPGScreenRouter. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_InputPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
CurrentScreenId and ModalStack: client-only, bounded and cleared on travel
InputContextPriority: world=0, targeting=10, UI=100 proposed
TextScale=1.0; supported preview range 0.8..1.5
ReducedMotion, ColorIndependentTelegraphs, Subtitles, HoldToggleSprint: local options
ActionBindings: keyboard/mouse first, controller-ready; no mobile layout
NotificationId and ResultCode: structured text keys, not raw backend exception text

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGScreenRouterImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_OptionsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
OpenScreen(ScreenId, ReadOnlyContext) -> Opened|NotReady; local only
CloseTopScreen(Reason) -> Closed; restore focus/input, not gameplay state
ApplyOptions(ValidatedOptions) -> Applied|UnsupportedValue; local presentation settings
SubmitIntent(CommandKind, Payload) -> Pending|InputBlocked; delegates to owned controller/domain component

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Enhanced Input local-player subsystem installs IMC_World only for the owning local player. A dedicated server has no UMG or local input setup.
  2. When inventory/dialogue opens, ScreenRouter saves focus and selects an explicit modal policy. The server world continues running.
  3. Widget button handlers call exposed request functions and immediately enter Pending; they never subtract wallet text or item quantities optimistically as committed facts.
  4. On accepted snapshot/receipt, update visible lists by stable item/quest identity and revision. On rejection show a localized reason and refresh affected data.
  5. On possession change, unbind old delegates, bind new PlayerState/components when ready, and perform one initial snapshot refresh.
  6. Travel/death/disconnect clears held actions and closes unsafe NPC/merchant/craft dialogs. Options may remain local, but no stale modal can issue a command against a new zone actor.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create IA_Move(Axis2D), IA_Jump(Boolean), IA_Sprint(Boolean), IA_Dodge(Boolean), IA_Interact(Boolean), IA_Primary(Boolean), IA_TargetNext(Boolean), IA_Zoom(Axis1D) only when their consuming phases arrive.
  2. Create IMC_World and IMC_UI. Map WASD, Space, Shift, a dodge key, E, mouse primary, Tab and wheel; add gamepad left stick, face buttons, triggers and D-pad counterparts with visible prompts.
  3. Create Widget Blueprints from UserWidget, name interactive controls explicitly and set IsFocusable for navigable controls. Use scalable panels/anchors and reusable row widgets only where repeated behavior exists.
  4. BP_RPGPlayerController creates ScreenRouter and the HUD only for IsLocalController. Never create UI in GameMode. Use input mode changes and focus explicitly; do not call SetGamePaused for a multiplayer menu.
  5. For each screen wire OnClicked/selection events to custom intent functions and bind read-only delegates once. Prefer event updates to bound functions that poll every frame.
  6. Test 1280x720 and 1920x1080, 150% text, keyboard only, controller only, no audio and a grayscale/colorblind review; localization keys must not be concatenated into English-only sentences.

Reopen Phase00 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_FrontEnd and L_NetworkLab / Controller_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Open two modals repeatedly -> one well-defined top focus target, no duplicate delegates or RPCs.
Press confirm while request pending -> same command retry or no second request, never duplicate purchase.
Client opens Options during enemy attack -> world/other players continue; health still updates.
Close NPC UI during transfer -> old interaction token invalidated and focus restored after new possession.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Bindings and UI scaling ranges are proposals. Store graphics/input preferences locally; server-important settings and consent flags require explicit authoritative records. Provide remapping and conflict detection before release.

Development overlay shows current input contexts, focus target, pending commands, state revision, ping and rejection codes. Production diagnostics hide secrets and internal stack traces.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
